settings.text: Little Explorers: keep it short and tear-free. A quick body wash, the 2-in-1 on wash day, and a bedtime massage oil.
Big Kids: playground grime needs a real clean. Body wash daily, 2-in-1 on wash day, hair oil twice a week.
